title: TikTok is rolling out new digital well-being features like an affirmation journal and says it will also give users badges for limiting their daily screen time (Ivan Mehta/TechCrunch)
summary: Ivan Mehta /TechCrunch:TikTok is rolling out new digital well-being features like an affirmation journal and says it will also give users badges for limiting their daily screen time—  TikTok is rolling out new digital well-being features like an affirmation journal and a background sound generator aimed at improving the mental health of its users.
